title: Red quartzite conduit and collection bowl at Abusir

tellings.quote: Below the eastern temple, there is a red quartzite conduit system. This red quartzite conduit goes underneath the black paving, black basalt paving of the eastern temple and it deposits into a red quartzite collection bowl.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who says an alien showed him the true purpose of the pyramids, says that below the eastern temple of the Pyramid of Niuserre at Abusir in Egypt there is "a red quartzite conduit system" running under the black basalt paving and emptying into "a red quartzite collection bowl." He tells Michels he saw it on a 2017 visit, crediting a man he names as Yousef Awyan. If true, it would suggest the pyramid was built to move and collect some liquid, like a machine.
